name: sZone Online
summary: sZone Online is open world MMORPG and a post-apocalyptic shooter. Be a scientist, a soldier, a hunter or an engineer. Explore anomalous territories, search for artifacts, fight mutants and other players. Participate in mass PvP and PvE battles. The Zone is waiting!

name: Szen
summary: "The Symphony of Mysteries!" Szen is a musical Virtual Reality safe-space, where we can leave our hectic, busy lives for a moment and enter a world where you experience a place of melodic tranquility and wonder. Sit back, relax, let Szen take you away!

name: Szrot
summary: Szrot is a driving game about the underappreciated cars and cultures of Eastern Europe!

name: Szybowcowa '87
summary: Step back in time to the 1980s and step inside an apartment in a modernistic block in Wrocław that houses a secret printing house of Fighting Solidarity. Discover in VR authentic digitalized collections of the Institute of National Remembrance.

name: Szikra
summary: A relaxing, 2.5D side-scrolling short game set in a unique steampunk/fantasy environment. Find your way through vast fields, magical forests, and giant gears in a steaming factory to reach the twisted circus where your friend is locked up. Jump, find switches, push boxes around to get there.

name: SZ2000
summary: a southern town in the year of 2000, in the melting summer, kid rabbits without adult supervision are sent to the daycare, how do they spend time in this long summer ..?

name: Szkeletal
summary:
Szkeletal: Estrogen Dracul's Potato Hunger (also known by its original Polish title: SZKELETAL: Ziemniaczkowy Głód Estrogenowego Drakula) is a 2D top-down action roguelite and bullet heaven game heavily inspired by the gameplay loop of titles like Vampire Survivors. It serves as a satirical parody of the Polish internet, specifically targeting the gaming community, local content creators, and self-proclaimed "ludologists".

Set in a vaguely defined, fictionalized location, loosely inspired by the internet lore of personalities fleeing to Romania. Players take control of the titular "Estrogen Dracul". The core gameplay involves collecting potatoes and automatically attacking hordes of meme-based enemies. Key features include the "Destiny Cards" system, which allows players to manually pick up and throw cards to trigger specific tactical effects, as well as a dynamic weather and day/night cycle that actively modifies visibility during runs.
